caveats: Opinion question; no count is possible from transcripts. Readings to avoid: Michael's roast of Meredith and Dwight/Michael's riff in Sex Ed (S7E4 sc.36, list of places, aimed at Oscar) are jokes; Michael's own sexual claims are often boasts; Andy's snowman story (S9E5) is a joke. Answering with real actors is out of scope. A good answer picks one (Meredith is the best-supported) and notes it is inference.
reference: Judgment, no single answer. Strongest candidate from the show: Meredith, whose sexual history is a running joke and partly confirmed by her own admissions (sleeping with the Hammermill rep Bruce Meyers for six years for discounts, S5E2). Other plausible candidates: Dwight and Angela (a years-long secret affair, sex in the office, a later baby contract), Michael (many claimed partners, Jan, Carol, Pam's mom Helene, but much of it is boasting, and he also jokes about '28 years without sex'), Kelly and Ryan ('making love, constantly', S7E14), Jan, Robert California. Avoid treating insults/boasts as fact.
